item.title: Constituents
item.description:
Did you know there’s a spotify playlist called “Songs About Water”?

Well, when I sat down to write this blog, I thought it might put me in the mood to write about water. And then I thought Wait, is this a common experience? This playlist has over 1k saves on Spotify, are all these people writing about water? Why are there so many songs about water? Why doesn’t the playlist contain Every Teardrop Is a Waterfall by Coldplay? Do these artists also sing about air?

item.title: What else am I doing?
item.description:
I am currently working on my environmental engineering honours project at UWA, investigating the relationship between purchasing power and thermal comfort in the housing market and aims to answer the question: If I cannot afford the median house price, will I be forced to buy into a more expensive area?

While findings might be confronting (especially to someone who would like to buy into the market like myself), I am excited about what this project can uncover. If we know the impacts of our house on our health, we can make informed decisions about where we choose to buy and what (if any) renovations we can do to improve conditions.
